tei:div.tei:head: PROPITIATORY PRAYERS FOR THE FIRST DAY.
tei:div.tei:note: The Propitiatory Prayers are commenced on the Sunday before New Year, except when the Festival occurs on Monday or Tuesday, when they are begun instead on the Sunday week previous to the Festival.
These Prayers are said at an early hour before the Morning Service.
The following Prayers, till “it is great,” page 7, are said every day before the Propitiatory Prayers, until the morning before the Day of Atonement.
The Reader says the following Kaddish—
From “And now,” till “have been of old,” is said in an under tone.
